Source

Based on the paper "High-Throughput Semi-Honest Secure Three-Party Computation with an Honest Majority", Toshinori Araki et al. CCS'16 The implementation uses a circuit describing a symmetric cypher with a sponge construction in which every permutation is derived, via a Feistel strucure, from two pseudo-randomly generated sboxes. Thus every party can build the same circuit from a common random key.
